name: Ballard Canyon
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Ballard Canyon calls itself Syrah territory, and more than half its vines are Syrah.
Strong winds, fog and big swings between day and night temper its heat.
Its Syrah has savory notes like the northern Rhône, with riper fruit, fuller body and softer, more plentiful tannins.

blurb.text: A canyon of about 7,800 acres at the center of the Santa Ynez Valley in Santa Barbara County, west of the town of Ballard, between Los Olivos and Solvang.
